confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors (beer, coffee, meals, wine) are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season and location. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer relationship (cocktail roughly 3x beer, wine glass roughly 1.5x beer). The FX observation comes from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange rates page, not a direct page read in this session.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional Portuguese pricing for mid-sized university and tourist cities, scaled down from Lisbon and Porto. Coimbra is cheaper than those two for food and lodging, with July demand reflecting summer tourism.
